_: THE SCHOOL ENQUIRY FORM'S ONE DEFINITION. JSON rather than TypeScript for the reason lib/seo/register.ts gives: the generator that renders this form is scripts/build-schools.mjs, an .mjs file that cannot import TypeScript. So the field list, the labels, the limits and the option vocabularies live here and are read by BOTH sides — the generator writes the markup from it and lib/school-enquiry.ts validates against it. A field the form shows that the API does not accept, or accepts and does not store, is the defect this file exists to make impossible. The PROGRAMME options are NOT here: they are derived from data/schools.json's own six rows, so the form cannot offer a programme the page does not list.
head: Ask about a programme
lead: Eleven boxes, three of them required. Enough to come back with something specific rather than a brochure.
thanks: Sent. One person reads these — Vimlendu Jha, Swechha's Executive Director — and will reply to the address you gave.
privacy: What you type here is stored so it can be answered: the school, your name and role, your email, your phone if you give one, and what you asked for. No IP address, no browser record and no note of which pages you read. It is not a mailing list and nothing is sent to you except a reply. Enquiries are deleted after twelve months.
fallback: Prefer email? The Ask below opens a message to the same person, with the same questions in it, and works with scripting off.

fields.label: School
fields.hint: The school's name as you would write it on a letter.

fields.label: Your role
fields.hint: Coordinator, head of department, principal — whatever fits.

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Phone
fields.hint: Optional. Leave it blank and you will be emailed instead.

options: A morning or half a day

fields.hint: Anything that would change the answer: a subject you are building it around, an access requirement, a fixed date, a budget you have to work inside.
